steps.do: Search for the product with shop_search (the user's saved ZIP is used automatically). If nothing fits, try one shorter query.
The options appear as product cards with a Choose button under your reply. In one or two sentences give your pick and why, and ask them to choose a card (and how many, if more than one).

Open the chosen product's checkout_url with browser_use. Fill in the user's name, email and their saved address copied exactly from memory, choose the cheapest shipping, and stop at the payment step. Never sign in to Shop Pay or any wallet; if Shop Pay or a saved card is selected, pick the plain credit card option so an empty card form shows. Read the exact items subtotal, shipping, tax and total. Don't enter any card details.

Call pay_with_link with the exact total, subtotal, shipping and tax in cents, the store's name and page, the item, ship_to set to the address you entered at checkout, and card_form_visible true. The user approves the breakdown in Clara first, then in Link. If they decline, stop.
After Link approval, call browser_use on the same checkout page with the spend_request id and tell it to use its pay action, which fills the one-time card and places the order.
Tell the user the result: the item, the store, the total and the order number shown on the confirmation page.
